purpose: Native importer handoff package for the next states after Ohio and Wisconsin.
notes: These packages point to official source artifacts already present in this repository.
Generated *-app-data.js bundles are listed only as reference outputs; native ETL should parse the official artifacts directly.
County geometry is available for these three states. Precinct/ward boundary geometry is not included in this package.
The sourceDiscoveryQueue tracks states where official local reporting-unit artifacts still need collection before native advisory flags can be calculated under the current methodology.

County-only presidential/result tables are not sufficient for comparable advisory flag generation; each review-capable state needs President plus a same-row comparison contest at precinct, ward, town, or equivalent local reporting-unit level.

states.name: Minnesota

presidentialCountyResults.sourceTitle: Minnesota SOS official federal/state precinct spreadsheet
presidentialCountyResults.parserHint: XLSX sheet Precinct-Results; aggregate COUNTYNAME rows using USPRSR, USPRSDFL, USPRSTOTAL, and other USPRS* candidate columns.

localReviewRows.parserHint: Use COUNTYNAME, MCDNAME, PCTNAME, USPRSR, USPRSDFL, USPRSTOTAL, USSENR, and USSENDFL.

caveats: County presidential totals can be aggregated from the precinct workbook; separate official county text files also exist for historical baseline.
Precinct boundary GeoJSON is not present in this package.

states.name: Michigan

presidentialCountyResults.sourceTitle: Michigan MVIC official county result export
presidentialCountyResults.parserHint: Tab-delimited MVIC county export; filter presidential electors contest and aggregate party/candidate rows by county.

localReviewRows.sourceTitle: Michigan MVIC official precinct result ZIP
localReviewRows.parserHint: Join 2024GEN/2024vote.txt to county, city, and candidate lookup tables. President officeCode 1; Senate officeCode 5.

turnout.sourceTitle: Michigan MVIC turnout export plus voter registration totals

caveats: MVIC live download endpoints are browser-protected; local official export artifacts are already stored in the repo.
Precinct boundary GeoJSON is not present in this package.

states.name: Pennsylvania

presidentialCountyResults.sourceTitle: Pennsylvania DOS precinct election returns bulk file
presidentialCountyResults.parserHint: Comma-delimited DOS precinct returns; filter officeCode USP and aggregate candidate/party rows by county.

localReviewRows.sourceTitle: Pennsylvania DOS precinct election returns bulk file
localReviewRows.parserHint: Use officeCode USP for President and USS for U.S. Senate; group by county, precinct code, municipality, ward, and precinct breakdown fields.

turnout.sourceTitle: Pennsylvania DOS vote history and voter registration summary

caveats: Official readme says the election returns data was extracted January 10, 2025; the direct bulk file name includes 20250129.
Precinct boundary GeoJSON is not present in this package.

states.name: Washington

presidentialCountyResults.sourceTitle: Washington SOS official all-counties CSV export
presidentialCountyResults.parserHint: CSV export; filter United States President/Vice President and aggregate county rows using Kamala D. Harris, Donald J. Trump, and other candidates.

localReviewRows.sourceTitle: Washington SOS official participating county precinct CSV export
localReviewRows.parserHint: Use Race, CountyCode, PrecinctName, PrecinctCode, Candidate, and Votes for President/Vice President and U.S. Senator.

turnout.denominator: EAC A1a Total Reg registered voters

caveats: County presidential totals reconcile to the official Washington all-state CSV.
The official participating precinct export aggregates to 3,918,934 presidential votes, 5,309 fewer than the certified county presidential total of 3,924,243.
Precinct boundary GeoJSON is not present in this package.
Turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 jurisdiction fallback data until an equal-or-finer Washington state source is collected.

states.name: Texas
states.authority: Texas Secretary of State; Texas Legislative Council Capitol Data Portal

presidentialCountyResults.sourceTitle: Texas SOS official 2024 general county JSON results
presidentialCountyResults.parserHint: Use race 1001 for certified county presidential rows and race 7958 for county U.S. Senate comparison totals when needed.

localReviewRows.sourceTitle: Texas Capitol Data Portal 2024 General Election VTD returns ZIP
localReviewRows.parserHint: Inside the ZIP, parse 2024_General_Election_Returns.csv; group by County/FIPS/VTD and compare Office=President with Office=U.S. Sen using Party D/R/other.

turnout.sourceTitle: Texas Capitol Data Portal 2024 General Election VTD VRTO rows

caveats: Certified county result rows remain sourced from Texas SOS County.json.
The Capitol Data Portal VTD presidential rows aggregate to 11,404,528 votes, 15,854 above the SOS County.json certified-result package total of 11,388,674.
VTD rows are official local screening context, not replacement certified totals.
VTD boundary GeoJSON is not present in this package.

For precinct-level rows, run scripts/ocr-ms-county-result-pdfs.mjs, run scripts/extract-ms-recap-grid-cells.mjs to produce review-gated cell candidates, reconcile/review the candidate CSV, then promote a structured precinct review artifact.
